name: design-lite
conclusion_quantitative: design-lite (Escalate) specifies 4 of 5 categories: 3 autonomy limits, 3 clarification rules, 1 approval gate, 1 validation rule; none for escalation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.
conclusion_qualitative: design-lite runs a lightweight design discussion with a fixed two-member team of agents, producing a design document in Korean. The agent interviews the user first, gets approval for the team, enforces a quality gate on proposals, and never modifies code. It sets no rules for escalating failures.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 3 autonomy limits (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 3 rules, all strict, 1 tied to a situation, all bullet points. The skill makes no code changes, only design discussion, and never spawns a refinement team, even when the user asks for deeper investigation.

statements.quote: NO code modifications allowed. Design discussion only.
If the user requests deeper investigation that would normally trigger a refinement team, do NOT spawn one.
NO code modifications. Design discussion only.

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 3 clarification rules (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There are 3 rules, all strict, 1 tied to a situation, all bullet points. Before forming a team the agent interviews the user with deep, specific questions, alternating with codebase exploration until coverage is sufficient, then confirms with the user before proceeding.

statements.quote: Do NOT create a team yet. First, interview the user to understand requirements.
Ask deep, non-obvious questions covering all aspects of the task
Iterate between interviewing and codebase exploration until coverage is sufficient, then confirm with the user before proceeding.

approval_gates.conclusion_quantitative: 1 approval gate (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in a bullet point. The two-member team is created only after the user approves its composition.

statements.quote: Only create the team after the user approves the composition (single Y/N gate — no iterative re-proposal cycle).

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 validation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in a bullet point. Before cross-review, each proposal must reference concrete code from the codebase and give reasons for its design decisions.

statements.quote: **Quality Gate**: Before cross-review, verify each proposal references concrete files/modules/patterns from the actual codebase and includes design decisions with rationale.

escalation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent what to do when something goes wrong, such as stopping or reporting an error to the user.
